<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — Every listed open value is exported in OPEN_CONSTANTS with the exact value given, and fixed values are in a separate FIXED_CONSTANTS group.
- A2: met — config.test.ts asserts each open value. The test files add no suppressions. Whether npm test passes is left to the deterministic run.
- A3: unverified — index.ts re-exports config, which is verified. Lint and typecheck results aren't visible in the diff, so they depend on the deterministic checks.
- A4: met — All three new files are under src/lib/analysis/.

<details><summary>1 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Object.hasOwn depends on the ES2022 lib `src/lib/analysis/config.ts:60` — Run npm run typecheck. Only switch to Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call if it fails.

</details>

suggestions.title: Object.hasOwn depends on the ES2022 lib
suggestions.detail: Object.hasOwn only typechecks if tsconfig's target or lib includes ES2022. The diff can't show this and tsconfig is a protected path, so check that npm run typecheck passes. If it fails, use Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(OPEN_CONSTANTS, name).
suggestions.fix: Run npm run typecheck. Only switch to Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call if it fails.
